description: NaMg₆AlO₈ is Caswellsilverite-derived structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.12 Å) and two longer (2.27 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are four shorter (2.12 Å) and two longer (2.35 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (2.01 Å) and four longer (2.12 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.18 Å. Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are two shorter (1.93 Å) and four longer (2.12 Å) Al-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Mg and one Al atom to form OMg₅Al octahedra that share corners with six equivalent OMg₅Al octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ONaMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₅Al octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Mg, and two equivalent Al atoms to form ONa₂Mg₂Al₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₂Al₂ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₅Al octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₂Al₂ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₅Al octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Mg, and two equivalent Al atoms to form ONa₂Mg₂Al₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₂Al₂ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₅Al octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. Both O-Mg bond lengths are 2.10 Å. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₂Al₂ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₅Al octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. Both O-Mg bond lengths are 2.18 Å.
